title: BGN U-shaped exposure (0.35, 0, 0, 0, 0.35) across a MILD visible level ladder 0.8..1.2, five types, exact compensation, price 2.5 (small firms constrained, large firms operationally levered) -- types reordered so the compensation's reference is the unexposed type at level 1.0
question: Does a U-shaped loading across size, with the story that the smallest and the largest firms are the exposed ones, give BGN room and a fair gap at the bar as the hump (bvyhx4) did?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-01). A non-monotone exposure with a simple story, built the same way in every model: five equal types on the mild visible level ladder 0.8..1.2 with the loading U-shaped across it, b = (0.28, 0, 0, 0, 0.28), exact y = 0 compensation (bv_comp 1.0) so that only size carries the U. Small firms are exposed to the aggregate cash-flow shock through financing constraints, large firms through operating leverage, mid-sized firms through neither. The hump twins (bvyhx4 / vyhx4 / gvyhx4, b = -c, 0, +c, 0, -c) are running; the U has no sign flip and all its exposure is of one sign, so its mean is not zero and the market holds the common part; the room is the curvature in size, which no linear function of the characteristics spans (bvyvee's V across the WIDE ladder 0.6..1.4 failed because the level's own monotone premium swamped it; the mild ladder and the larger loading are bvyhx3/4's fix).

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

LADDER (2026-11-01 19:45): bvyu4 (0.28) gave room 18-121% and a fair gap of +0.014 (t 1.3, seven of ten), below the bar; the hump went from +0.035 at 0.21 to +0.119 at 0.28, so this is the next rung. REORDER (2026-11-01 21:10): bvyu5 failed the gate (type 0 realised +0.006 vs expected +0.065, z -7.3; J*(rbar, 0) = 0 for type 0). The y = 0 compensation is referenced to type 0 (type_theta = (D0[0]/D0[f])^bv_comp x level), and in the U type 0 was the SMALL EXPOSED type, whose positive exposure is discounted under Q (the Q-mean of y is about -7 sd); every type was scaled down to that low value and the level-0.8 type had no positive-NPV project. Here the unexposed type at level 1.0 comes first, so the exposed types are scaled UP to match it: the same five types, the same economics, a usable scale. (bvyu4 at 0.28 passed with the exposed reference, which also explains its low values and may have dulled its gap.) PREDICTION (2026-11-01): premium U-shaped in size; oracle room 30% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029 in BGN (bvyhx4 gave +0.119 with the sign flip); KP14 and GS21 as their hump twins. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 15% on three seeds.
